mapper.update: UPDATE resource_slot SET status = IF(reserved_count + 1 >= booking_capacity, 'FULL', 'AVAILABLE'), reserved_count = reserved_count + 1, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE slot_id = #{slotId} AND status IN ('AVAILABLE', 'FULL') AND reserved_count < booking_capacity

UPDATE resource_slot SET status = IF(status = 'FULL', 'AVAILABLE', status), reserved_count = GREATEST(reserved_count - 1, 0), version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE slot_id = #{slotId} AND reserved_count > 0
